C. Right-of-Way Requirements
The widening and reconstruction of Lincoln Highway will be accompanied by increased right-of-way requirements as follows:
From Cicero to Western Avenue a width of 116 feet is generally required. The existing width varies from 66 to 160 feet. Approximately 12.4 acres of land will be acquired.
2. From Western Avenue to Edgewood Avenue a width of 92 feet is generally required, however this width will be reduced where feasible in order to avoid building acquisitions. The existing width varies from 66 to 83 feet. Approximately 3.5 acres of land will be acquired.
3. From Edgewood Avenue to Aberdeen Street a width of 76.5 feet is generally required. The existing right-of-way is 69.5 feet. Approximately 0.10 acres of land will be acquired.
4. At the Roosevelt School approximately 0.20 acres of land will be acquired.
5. From the Cook County Forest Preserve District approximately 0.17 acres of land will be required for a "temporary construction easement".
D. Location of Major Design Features
The improvement of Lincoln Highway will require major structural changes at the Illinois Central Railroad overpass. The proposed highway at this point will have six through lanes and one right-turn lane and will require an entirely new railroad bridge. A new bridge will offer opportunities to improve transportation facilities at the Illinois Central Railroad station and adjacent parking lots. Better and safer access to the railroad station can be provided as part of this highway improvement, including the use of the new railroad structure for terminal and pedestrian overpass facilities.
The proposed project will include improvements in present intersection characteristics. Cicero Avenue on the western end of the proposed improvement and Chicago Road on the eastern end have been previously reconstructed.
